aiSummary.oneLiner: A cryptographic utility library focusing on lightweight key management and generation.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: YellowKey is a lightweight cryptographic library designed to simplify key generation and management for small-scale applications. It provides straightforward APIs for generating secure asymmetric and symmetric keys. The repository focuses on minimizing dependencies, making it easy to integrate into resource-constrained environments. It includes utilities for securely storing and retrieving keys from local storage. The project emphasizes security best practices while keeping the developer experience simple. It aims to prevent common cryptographic pitfalls in basic application development.
keyFeatures: Key generation: Simplifies the creation of robust symmetric and asymmetric encryption keys.
Secure storage: Provides mechanisms for safely storing and retrieving cryptographic material.
Minimal dependencies: Operates with a very small footprint for easy integration.
Simple API: Offers a clean interface to abstract away complex cryptographic operations.
Format conversion: Handles the serialization and deserialization of various key formats.

useCases.title: Application security
useCases.description: Generate and manage encryption keys for securing local application data.

useCases.title: IoT integration
useCases.description: Utilize lightweight cryptographic functions in resource-constrained IoT devices.

useCases.title: Cryptographic learning
useCases.description: Study the implementation to understand basic key management principles.

useCases.title: Key conversion
useCases.description: Convert cryptographic keys between different standard formats easily.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: YellowKey is designed for developers needing basic cryptographic functionalities without overhead. It is suitable for IoT engineers working on devices with limited storage and processing power. Students learning about applied cryptography can use it as a practical reference.
